leadText:
A School Kid (Japanese: がえり Coming Home from Cram School), or Schoolkid, is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation II games as Schoolboys. In Generation III, female variations were introduced and the class gained a gender-neutral name. They are presented as young children carrying school bags, with the boys then growing up to become s. 
In Pokémon GO, "Schoolkid" is the name of an achievement awarded for catching at least 10 Pokémon.
